cardPage.title: Pay by card
cardPage.intro: Enter your card details below. They go straight to our card payment provider, never to us.
cardPage.noscript: This page needs JavaScript to show the secure card fields.
cardPage.hostedNote: The card fields are run by our card payment provider. Your bank may ask you to confirm the payment.
cardPage.processing: We are checking your payment. This can take a few minutes. You can close this page and check your booking later.
cardPage.unavailable: Card payments are not available right now. Go back to your booking and try again later.

failed.declined: Your card was declined. Start again from your booking to use another card.
failed.notAuthenticated: Your bank did not confirm the payment. Start again from your booking to try again.
failed.busy: Too many payments were being made at once. Start again from your booking in a few minutes.
failed.generic: This payment could not be completed. Start again from your booking.

errors.notFound: We could not find this payment. Start again from your booking.
errors.notOpen: This payment is no longer open. Start again from your booking.
errors.underReview: This booking is being reviewed. Contact us before paying.
errors.invalid: Something was wrong with the card details. Check them and try again.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.checkCard: Check your card details and try again.
errors.fieldsUnavailable: The secure card fields could not be loaded. Reload the page or try again later.
errors.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Start again from your booking.
errors.phoneRequired: Your bank needs a phone number to confirm card payments. Add one to your account details, then try again.
errors.challengeUnavailable: Your bank's check could not be shown. Reload the page or try again later.
